g.text: Classic Peter Chen Notation with Geometric Shapes: Rectangles (Entities), Diamonds (Relationships), Ovals (Attributes), Underlined Keys
Traditional ER Notation Legend (Peter Chen Standard)
Cardinality Ratios: 1:1 (One-to-One), 1:N (One-to-Many), M:N (Many-to-Many). Double Borders denote existence dependency.
